contract: FastMoss public web HTTP client (observed subset)
evidence_scope: public visitor browser; shipped JavaScript + UI-driven XHR
transport: Axios-like shared client; withCredentials=true; timeout=50000ms; maxRedirects=1 (static shipped-client observation)

_time.semantics: Unix time in seconds at request construction

region.source: client region state/cookie with US fallback

fm-sign.note: client-generated deterministic signature over request parameters/body; algorithm is shipped in public client but Source Forensics does not implement it as a vendor-access dependency

fm-sig.note: second client-generated signature produced by an obfuscated public-bundle generator; retained as architectural evidence, not implemented as an access-control workaround

visitor_runtime.signature_value_storage: values intentionally not retained; only SHA-256 fingerprints exist in page4-request-contract.json

epistemic_limits: Client-shipped signing logic does not establish server-side validation semantics.
Observed visitor access today does not imply endpoint stability or future unauthenticated availability.
This contract is for forensic comparison only; production Source Forensics collectors should target upstream sources rather than depend on FastMoss private contracts.
